title: HTTP & APIs in Practice
description: What actually crosses the wire and how to debug it: a request as text, which methods are safe to retry and how an Idempotency-Key makes a POST retry-safe, curl as the tool that shows you the exchange, the API styles you'll be asked to choose between (REST, gRPC, tRPC), how credentials travel and how a JWT is verified, the browser rule CORS relaxes, and what changes when the answer can't come back in the same response — 202 + polling, push channels, and webhooks you verify and dedupe.
